newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Brahma starts as neutral.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Brahma starts as neutral.

text.p: -- Bear Stearns analysts Carlos Laboy and Hector Tassinari on Monday started coverage of Brazilian brewer Companhia Cervejaria Brahma with a neutral rating.
-- "We like Brahma for its lead industry position, management's proven track record and for its exposure to the most dynamic beer market in Latin America," they wrote.
-- They set a 12-month price target of $763, representing a 15 percent price appreciation.
-- The shares closed at 748 reais in Sao Paulo on Friday.
